reason: The README describes a CLI plugin that lets an agent inspect and operate existing tmux sessions, including sending keystrokes, running commands, monitoring jobs, capturing output, rearranging panes, and gated termination.

summaries.zh: 通过结构化工具让智能体列出、驱动、捕获、拆分、交换、运行和监视 tmux 终端窗格。
summaries.en: Provides structured tools for an agent to list, drive, capture, split, swap, run commands in, and watch tmux terminal panes.

capabilities: Lists tmux sessions, windows, and panes
Sends literal text and Enter keystrokes to targeted panes
Creates, swaps, runs commands in, watches, and kills tmux panes or related scopes
Injects watch results as durable context and renders capture snapshots
